utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I was just telling Eli about it—we're gonna get everyone fixing up the park benches this Saturday!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Nice, that sounds like a great plan! I can bring my toolbox and help with any loose screws or broken planks.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, that's perfect! I was just telling Jules about how we need folks with tools—you'll be a huge help this Saturday!

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure, Friday evening works for me. I'll have them ready for you.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus. I'll swing by after work to pick them up.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds like a plan. I’ll leave `em on the porch if I’m not home yet.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Eli, do you know if we have enough duct tape for the repair drive? I want to make sure we're not short on anything.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I checked my supply last night—I've got three rolls in the shed. That should hold us unless someone's planning on wrapping their whole porch with it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Three rolls? That's more than I thought we'd have. I'll mark that down as good news—duct tape crisis averted.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Wait, next Saturday? I thought it was this weekend—did I miss something?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, we moved it to next Saturday to avoid clashing with the school bake sale. Sorry for the confusion!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Ah, right—bake sale. My kids wouldn't let me forget that one. Next Saturday sounds good, then.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, the repair drive is for the community center computer. Let me double-check the file list before we proceed.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh, thanks Hana. Let me know if you need anything else from me.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Actually, Uli, could you confirm the file version with Pia? She mentioned it might be v2.3 but wants to check her binder.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Dane, glad you're on board for the repair drive! It's this Saturday, we're fixing up the park benches—should be a fun way to get the whole neighborhood together.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good, Jules—I'll be there, just don't expect me right at the crack of dawn, okay?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries, Dane! We'll probably start around 9, so you've got time to sleep in a bit.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Mina, just heard from Vik—we're getting folks to fix up the park benches this Saturday!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, you're working on that repair drive? Is it for the community center computer?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, that's the one! We're starting with the benches, but I'm hoping to branch out if people bring other stuff too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I'm just about to grab my binder to confirm the version—give me one moment to make sure we're all on the same page before we proceed.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Of course, take your time! I always double-check my maps before heading anywhere—the community center is just past the old oak tree on Maple Street, right?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, that's right—Maple Street, just past the oak tree. I'm pulling out the binder now.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, Rosa, are you talking about that repair drive? I thought Sam got it all wrong.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, a repair drive? I hadn't heard about that—can you fill me in?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So you haven't heard about it either? Then who's actually running this thing?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Bo, I was just talking to Cleo about the repair drive—she wanted me to double-check we've got enough screwdrivers. Have you heard if folks are bringing in good stuff?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Uh, I caught bits of it—Rosa asked me to help with fences and porches. Dane's bringing his toolbox, so I think we're good on screwdrivers.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that's a relief! Dane's toolbox is always well-stocked. I'll let Cleo know we're set on screwdrivers.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Leo! We're organizing a big repair drive this Saturday at the community center. Can we count you in?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes, I'll be there with my tools.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Awesome, Leo! I'll put you down and spread the word to a few more folks—see you Saturday with those tools!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That's wonderful, Mara! I'm so glad you're already coordinated with Dane — I just wanted to let you know we've moved the drive to Sunday at the community center instead of Saturday on the porch.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Oh, thanks for the heads-up, Rosa! Sunday at the community center works for me — I'll make sure Dane knows about the change too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, thank you Mara! That's a huge help — I'll update the flyers and let the others know about the switch.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, so we're all set for next Saturday for the repair drive. I'll update the flyers and spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Next Saturday? I didn't even know about it until now—count me in if you need an extra pair of hands.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, thank you Nell! I was just about to start updating everyone, so that's perfect timing.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hey Pia, just a heads up: the repair drive has been moved to Sunday at the community center instead of Saturday at the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Wait, the community center? But I already printed schedules for the front porch—now I'll have to redo all the coordination lists.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, I'm so sorry, Pia—I know that's a pain. But the community center has better space and parking, so I think it'll be worth the switch.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So the repair drive is real then? How can you be sure it'll actually fix anything?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, it's definitely real—we've got a solid crew already, and folks like Jules and Vik are spreading the word, so I think we'll get plenty of hands to make a real difference this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Hold on, Ira — Jules told me he thought it was a scam. You sure he's actually on board?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, it's coming along... slowly. I appreciate everyone's help.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: You know, Eli was saying he hopes it's in the morning—I think that's the plan, but we should make sure everyone knows the time.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, morning works for me. I'll make sure the time is clear on the flyer.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure Quinn, I'd love to join! Just let me know what you need me to bring.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey, sorry I'm late—I'm in too. What should I bring?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Dane, glad you're in! Quinn said it's at the community center Saturday. I'm bringing some basic tools—maybe you could grab extra gloves or cleaning supplies?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Leo, we're gathering supplies for the repair drive. Do you have any extra tools we could borrow?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got the tools. Want me to look at the drive now?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That would be great, Leo. Thanks for offering to take a look.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, I checked my map of the neighborhood — the community center is definitely past the old oak tree on Maple Street. I can even show you the exact spot if you need help finding it!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good, I could use the help. Is that drive for the community center computer?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, are you talking about the computer repair? I think they're fixing the whole center, but I did hear someone mention a desktop that's been acting up.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive? I think I heard something about that... could you remind me what we're fixing again?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, it's mostly small appliances and electronics folks want to fix up. I've got my tools ready in the garage.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Small appliances and electronics... right, right. I think I have an old toaster that's been acting up. Should I bring that by?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Jules, I've got a full set of wrenches and a power drill ready to go. Just say the word and I'll bring 'em over to the community center.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That's awesome, Gus! The park benches are going to look great with your tools. See you Saturday morning at the community center!

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Alright, I'll be there bright and early with my toolbox.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Huh, a repair drive? I think I saw a flyer about it, but I can't remember the details. Something about fixing up the community center?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, that's it! We're gathering this Saturday to fix the community center's broken benches and doors. Do you have any tools you could lend, Noah?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Tools? Let me think—I've got a rusty hammer somewhere in the garage. I'll try to find it before Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Well, Quinn, just so you know, the repair drive is this Saturday at 9 AM sharp. Vik's got it all set up, and Rey's bringing tools. Hope you can make it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Sounds great, Eli! I'll be there, and I can rally a few more folks to join us.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Glad to hear it, Quinn. The more hands we have, the quicker we'll get things done.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Let me just confirm with Pia's binder first before we move forward.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Uh, sure, go ahead—just let me know if you need me to bring any tools or something.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I'll check Pia's binder to confirm the driver version. I'll let you know if we need any tools.
